write_up: You’ve moved from department supervisor to store manager at Carolina Home & Garden. Your resume gives a recruiter a clear picture of the store you run and the results you’ve delivered. The question is your headline: it claims two turnarounds, but the work beneath it doesn’t establish both.

The turnover line is a strong model. It shows where turnover started, where it landed, and the scheduling change you made. Your current role also puts the store’s sales and staffing right up front, so a recruiter can see the scale of your job.

Start with the headline. If you turned around both stores, show what happened at each one in the relevant role. If the second claim needs more qualification, narrow it. The rest already makes a solid case for store management.
